question: After real Android behavior evidence is added, should the owner-safe composer baseline be approved for this state-store refactor?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label and the risk to session-bound media and send admission require an owner decision after evidence verifies that the refactor preserves the merged behavior.

options.title: Require owner-transition proof before approval
options.body: Request a redacted emulator or device run that demonstrates draft or attachment isolation and send-admission behavior across an owner alias transition before human merge review.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: A responsible Android owner may explicitly override the real-behavior gate if an equivalent trusted integration proof is available outside the PR body.

recommendation.title: Require owner-transition proof before approval
recommendation.body: Request a redacted emulator or device run that demonstrates draft or attachment isolation and send-admission behavior across an owner alias transition before human merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged session-safe composer behavior whose invariant this refactor centralizes.
